He also sends helpers to deal with reports of pink elekks troubling the celebrations, though he finds the notion of pink elekks preposterous.
Wild wolpertingers are elusive beasts attracted to the smells of Brewfest. The festival hunter Goldark seeks to catch them with a net; a successful hit leaves one stunned and ready to be collected.

The Brewfest Setup Crew are festival workers preparing the grounds before the celebration. They are busy with the work and look forward to finishing so they can enjoy the festivities; they expect the setup to take a little longer.
A Thunderbrew apprentice represents the Thunderbrew brewhouse as a vendor. The apprentice takes pride in the brewhouse, claiming it is the best in all the realms, and offers its goods to visitors.
A Gordok brew apprentice represents the Gordok brewhouse as a vendor. The apprentice is surprised that a visitor wants to buy from them and offers the brewhouse's goods.
Anne Summers is a cheese vendor who offers goods for browsing.
Arlen Lochlan is a bread vendor who offers goods for browsing.
Brother Cartwright is a wine vendor who offers goods for browsing.
Headless Horseman - Fire (DND) is a scripted fire hazard used in the Fire Brigade Practice exercise, where participants douse fires with water buckets.

Neill Ramstein is a Brewfest Ram Racing Master who lends racing reins and rams, coaches racers, and organizes keg runs from Kharanos. He identifies Pol Amberstill as his apprentice and directs racers to him for handling instructions; Flynn Firebrew supplies the kegs, which racers carry to Pol.

Becan Barleybrew represents the Barleybrews at Brewfest, recruiting help to advertise their brewery at flags around Ironforge. His pitch offers a racing ram and reins for the task; his reward dialogue says the Barleybrews keep their word.

Daran Thunderbrew promotes the Thunderbrews at Brewfest, recruiting help to advertise their brewery at flags around Ironforge. He frames the task as a contest with the Barleybrews, disparaging their messengers and promises, and says the Thunderbrews reward helpers with prizes.
Maeve Barleybrew is identified as a Brewmaiden.
Ita Thunderbrew is identified as a Brewmaiden.
The Gordok Brew Barker advertises ogre brews in short, emphatic calls, urging passersby to drink and praising the brew’s strength and quality.
The Gordok Brew Chief is identified by a leadership role among the Gordok brew sellers at Brewfest.
The Drunken Brewfest Reveler is a festival-goer whose drinking has clearly gotten ahead of them, adding a rowdy presence to the Brewfest celebrations.

Belbi Quikswitch is Brewfest’s goggle-wearing token redeemer, ready to exchange tokens and handle other festival transactions. She greets visitors with playful, openly flirtatious banter and jokes about the attention she gets; her menu also points visitors to the Brew of the Month club and her wares.
The Touring Orphan has a brief, unsettled greeting and mourns that a late parent cannot put out the fires, with separate lines naming their mother or father.
S.T.O.U.T. is a Brewfest practice target built for mug-throwing. It registers spell hits and serves as a target for testing a visitor’s aim.
A numbered Brewfest bark trigger tied to the Thunderbrew announcement task at Ironforge’s flags. It serves the event’s shouting objective rather than appearing as a named messenger.
A numbered Brewfest bark trigger tied to the Thunderbrew announcement task at Ironforge’s flags. It serves the event’s shouting objective rather than appearing as a named messenger.
A numbered Brewfest bark trigger tied to the Thunderbrew announcement task at Ironforge’s flags. It serves the event’s shouting objective rather than appearing as a named messenger.
During the Brewfest keg run, Flynn Firebrew waits on a hill near Kharanos with the kegs. He tosses one to a passing rider, who carries it back to Pol Amberstill.
A racing ram, identified as a mount animal for racing.
A swift racing ram, distinguished by its name from the Racing Ram.

Pol Amberstill is the Ram Racing Apprentice at the Dun Morogh Brewfest grounds. He answers questions about ram speed, tiring and riding mounts, and helps visitors learn how ram racing works. Visitors with an Honorary Brewer stamp can approach him about Brewfest riding rams; his festival role centers on helping guests take part in the races.

The Costumed Orphan Matron is a caretaker who worries for village children when the Headless Horseman threatens them. She rallies visitors to help with fires and directs them to local fire brigade practice areas. She thanks helpers, invokes the Light, and says visits from heroes lift the children's spirits. Her role centers on keeping children safe and encouraging the community to protect them.

Ipfelkofer Ironkeg organizes Brewfest outside Ironforge, welcomes questions and celebrates friendly competition between breweries. He distrusts Dark Iron promises after their sabotage, yet thanks those who help. Their Dire Brew wins his admiration despite that hostility: he envies the Dark Iron dwarves and calls the drink possibly Brewfest’s best.

The Dun Morogh Flame Warden urges visitors to honor the local festival flame and others in Alliance settlements. The warden welcomes fellow celebrants but calls the Horde’s fires unworthy and encourages their desecration.

A Master Fire Eater teaches the fire festival’s torch-catching tricks, confident in their own skill but warning students to take care around the flames. Their greetings celebrate the festival and invite visitors to honor the local flame.

An arena battlemaster handles arena challenges, with a blunt manner toward would-be fighters. One conditional exchange dismisses a character as unfit for the Steamwheedle Fighting Circuit; the battlemaster’s arena option offers a way to enter a fight.
An Arena Organizer serves as a petitioner for guild formation. Their available petition option points visitors toward information on how to form a guild.
A humanoid paymaster.
A Midsummer Supplier serves the fire festival as a goods vendor, allowing visitors to browse the supplier’s wares.

An Earthen Ring elder who treats the Twilight Cult as a threat to the balance the Ring fights to preserve. In public, they call stopping the cult a sworn duty, warning that its success would undo their work. Their appeal is urgent and collective, rooted in responsibility for the balance.
A humanoid beastmaster.
A weapons vendor who also repairs equipment, offering visitors both arms and maintenance. Their work is practical and direct: they keep weapons available and help adventurers restore damaged gear.
A druid trainer.
This mage trainer teaches the ways of the mage and offers talent and pet-skill resets.
This paladin trainer teaches the ways of the paladin and offers talent and pet-skill resets.
This priest trainer teaches the ways of the priest and offers talent and pet-skill resets.
This rogue trainer teaches the ways of the rogue and offers talent and pet-skill resets.

A warrior training pedestal used as a world-event helper, appearing across many regions. It offers access to goods; the records do not show it teaching warrior skills or speaking as a person.
The Fight Promoter is identified as an Arena Battlemaster's Assistant.
The Fight Promoter's Tar Pedestal provides vendor and repair services.

Boxey Boltspinner built S.T.O.U.T. as a stein-throwing training target and encourages careful practice. At Brewfest, Boxey takes the Dark Iron threat to the camp seriously and celebrates those who help defend it.

Larkin Thunderbrew represents the Brew of the Month Club. The club offers members access to new brews, with monthly deliveries and the option to buy more. Larkin handles membership paperwork and presents the club as a source of good beer.
A Brew of the Month Club vendor offers the club’s monthly brew and explains that its brews are exclusive to members.
A Brew of the Month Club vendor sells the monthly brew exclusively to club members.

Pella Brassbrush is a barber, a specialist in personal grooming.

Marga Bearbrawn serves as the Strand of the Ancients battlemaster. She warns that the Horde might exploit the strand’s hidden secrets and calls for soldiers to join its defenders. Her dialogue also cautions that the battle requires sufficient experience.
Elise Brightletter teaches Inscription.
Thargen Heavyquill is an inscription supplies vendor. His inscription-focused stock distinguishes him from a general goods seller.

A Spring Collector is an egg-hunt researcher seeking shell samples to investigate the magic used to create Noblegarden eggs. The collector asks capable egg hunters for help and points them toward mages recruiting in nearby settlements.

The Noblegarden Vendor offers an Egg Basket for the egg hunt and asks participants to return with chocolates. The vendor handles Noblegarden goods and exchanges, and welcomes visitors to join the celebration.
Chapman is a Day of the Dead vendor.

Catrina welcomes the Day of the Dead as a time when the spirit world draws close. Catrina explains that flowers, candles and offerings on graves welcome loved ones back for a while, and invites others to dance, cherish the departed and make them feel loved.

The Cheerful Dwarf Spirit in Ironforge’s graveyard enjoys visiting friends and family, celebrating and sharing old stories. Having eaten everything prepared for the visit, the spirit politely asks for more Bread of the Dead and gratefully offers a small holiday gift in return.

The Cheerful Gnome Spirit in Ironforge’s graveyard enjoys visiting friends and family again. Having eaten everything prepared for the visit, the spirit politely asks for more Bread of the Dead and gratefully offers a small holiday gift in return.

Edward Winslow helps with the Pilgrim’s Bounty feast outside Ironforge. He praises tangy Wetlands cranberry chutney and asks for some to be taken to Jasper Moore outside Stormwind, fulfilling a promised trade for pumpkin pie. Edward reports that the pie has been a hit with the dwarves and welcomes more when supplies run low.
Elizabeth Barker Winslow is a Pilgrim’s Bounty vendor whose goods visitors can browse.

The Bountiful Table Hostess welcomes guests to the Pilgrim’s Bounty feast, invites them to take a seat, and encourages them to try every dish. Her greeting also points visitors toward the shared table service, while her conversation explains how the tables work.

Caitrin Ironkettle is a cooking trainer whose holiday workload has left her struggling to keep the feast supplied. She describes juggling chutney, sweet potatoes, and pies before realizing she has forgotten the stuffing; she also says turkey is hard to come by. Her replies show relief and gratitude when visitors bring the dishes she needs.

Borim Goldhammer serves as a battlemaster. His battleground conversation asks whether visitors are ready to fight for the Alliance and includes a warning that some characters are not yet seasoned enough to enter.

Lixa Felflinger serves as a battlemaster. Her battleground conversation asks whether visitors are ready to fight for the Alliance and includes a warning that some characters are not yet seasoned enough to enter.
Lynette Bracer is an Alliance battlemaster for the Isle of Conquest. She warns that the island’s valuable resources must not fall into Horde hands and invites eligible combatants to join the fight.
Farseer Eannu is an Earthen Ring shaman who listens to the elemental spirits and urges others to heed their warnings. He says he has seen firsthand what can happen when those warnings are ignored.
A ghostly dwarf celebrant returns to visit with friends and family, celebrating and sharing stories of old.
A ghostly gnome celebrant returns to visit with friends and family, celebrating and sharing stories of old.

Arcanist Laniria is a Wintergrasp battle-mage who directs combatants to support her side’s forces and offers entry to the battle around its scheduled start. Her guidance responds to the changing battle state.
The Lovely Merchant represents Crown Chemical Co. and offers its goods for browsing. This named vendor appears across several event areas, giving the company a merchant presence in multiple regions.

The Public Relations Agent represents Crown Chemical Co. with an upbeat sales pitch, offering visitors a gift, a job, or something for themselves. They point customers to the company's mascot, Kwee, or the nearby Lovely Merchant when they need something the agent cannot provide.

Kwee Q. Peddlefeet is Crown Chemical's official event mascot and an authorized distributor of Lovely Charm Collector's Kits. Kwee promotes the Charitable Charms program, explaining how charms can become bracelets for loved ones or tokens through Lovely Merchants, and suggests making bracelets for admired leaders.

The Junior Inspector is a Steamwheedle investigator suspicious of Crown Chemical Co., joking that something stinks beyond their socks. They invite interested recruits to join the inquiry and point them toward Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Stormwind.
A disassembled mechanical mechano-tank in Dun Morogh.
A Gnomeregan medic keeps watch in case recruits faint or overexert themselves during training. The medic also mentions occasional mechano-tank prototype explosions.
A Gnomeregan trainee is one of the recruits undergoing training. The trainee can be prompted to salute as part of that instruction.
Drill Sergeant Steamcrank trains recruits to be soldiers, emphasizing discipline, salutes, and battle roars. His cues are part of the recruits’ basic training.
Pilot Muzzlesprock offers a flying machine for work around Gnomeregan. The assignment is to throw Radiageigatrons at nearby ventilation shafts so radiation levels can be measured.
'Thunderflash' is a flying machine described as powerful enough to carry one gnome, perhaps two. It can be boarded and is used in the radiation survey around Gnomeregan.

A Gnome Citizen from Tinker Town, one of the gnomes sought as a pilot for the assault on Gnomeregan. An experimental Motivate-a-Tron is meant to give citizens the courage to enlist, though its effects are still uncertain.

Captain Tread Sparknozzle oversees recruits preparing for the Gnomeregan campaign. He sends a new helper through Drill Sergeant Steamcrank’s tough training, then welcomes them back with a joking measure of their grit. He also receives Toby Zeigear’s proposed battle speech, praises the writing, and reports that a strike team is heading to Gnomeregan.

Toby Zeigear is a speechwriter tasked with preparing High Tinker Mekkatorque’s pre-battle address. Unsure which of his drafts works best, he asks for local gnomes’ reactions to recorded samples. Their differing responses surprise him, but help him settle on a speech; Tread later praises Toby’s writing.
A humanoid known as Mechano-Tank Attack Target, found in Dun Morogh.
An ejector mechano-tank, a mechanical construct found in Dun Morogh.
A scuttling mechano-tank, a mechanical construct found in Dun Morogh.
A mechanical tank built for ranged attacks.

place_records.text: You are in Dun Morogh, Alliance land in the Eastern Kingdoms. Kharanos, Coldridge Valley, Gol'Bolar Quarry and Iceflow Lake are its Alliance settlements, and mining keeps many of its people busy. Rockjaw troggs break into the quarries and passes, Frostmane trolls keep their own hold, and snow leopards prowl the land.

You are in Kharanos, a town in Dun Morogh held by the Alliance. Its inn serves travelers, and trainers of arms, magic and the Light teach here. Field investigator Senir Whitebeard tracks Frostmane trolls, and Ozzie Togglevolt and Razzle Sprysprocket are working on a cure for the sickness that plagues Gnomeregan.

You are in Coldridge Valley, an Alliance valley in Dun Morogh. Troggs keep attacking it, and Balir Frosthammer is short of hands to drive them back after an attack overran the western camp. Gnomeregan refugees have come here too, and Felix Whindlebolt is anxious to recover the tools that trolls took to camps southwest of Anvilmar.

You are in Gnomeregan, a gnomish city made uninhabitable by radiation. Leper gnomes and addled lepers roam the city, and Onin MacHammar, a dwarf informant, works near it while hidden among the lepers. Evacuees are still seeking a way out, anguished at how close they came.

You are in Gol'Bolar Quarry, a mining site in Dun Morogh held by the Alliance. Rockjaw troggs have wrecked the work here, and Foreman Stonebrow is furious about it. Senator Mehr Stonehallow has taken charge of the trogg threat at the quarry, and Rockjaw Skullthumpers and Bonesnappers still prowl it.
You are in Frostmane Hold, where the Frostmane trolls live. Headhunters, snowstriders and hideskinners are among them, and ice claw bears and snow leopards prowl the area too.

You are in The Grizzled Den, a den in Dun Morogh where wendigos roam. Wendigos and their young hunt here alongside juvenile snow leopards and young black bears. A courier was chased off by wendigos near here and lost a crate of ammunition.

You are in Brewnall Village, a village in Dun Morogh held by the Alliance. Its brewers are the Barleybrews, and Rejold Barleybrew wants shimmerweed from the Frostmane trolls for an experimental stout. Marleth Barleybrew keeps up a rivalry with the Thunderbrew family in Kharanos, and ice claw bears and snow leopards wander close.

You are in Steelgrill's Depot, a depot in Dun Morogh where Siege Brigade pilots prepare their vehicles. Pilot Stonegear wants to outfit the siege engine Trollplow, and Pilot Bellowfiz is readying Jetsteam for long missions. Milli Featherwhistle sells mechanostriders, and Loslor Rudge runs an engineering-supplies shop here. Young black bears wander close by.

You are in Iceflow Lake, an Alliance area of Dun Morogh. Tristane Shadowstone sends young hunters on to taming teachers so they can earn a companion. Winter wolves, starving winter wolves, ice claw bears and snow leopards roam the area.

You are in Helm's Bed Lake, an area of Dun Morogh where Rockjaw troggs lurk. Rockjaw ambushers, bonesnappers, skullthumpers and backbreakers are all about, and wild Scarred Crag Boars charge at anyone who engages them.

You are in Ironband's Compound, a compound in Dun Morogh where Dark Iron dwarves are about. Dark Iron spies and Captain Beld are the dangers here. Narm Faulk fell holding off the Dark Iron dwarves so Muiredon Battleforge could escape, before the captain's orders were secured.

You are in Coldridge Pass, a mountain pass in Dun Morogh leading toward Kharanos. Troggs infest the tunnel through it, and Rockjaw raiders are about. Mountaineer Thalos warns travelers that they may be asked to wait in Anvilmar until it is safer, and Hands Springsprocket cannot get through it himself and needs a package carried to the inn in Kharanos.

You are in Chill Breeze Valley, a valley in Dun Morogh. Wendigos roam it, and the hunter Tundra MacGrann has lost his winter supply of dried meat to Old Icebeard, a beast who carried off the locked meat locker to his cave. MacGrann is too hurt to go after it himself.
You are in Shimmer Ridge, a ridge in Dun Morogh. Frostmane seers, snowstriders and headhunters roam it, and wendigos prowl alongside them.

You are in Amberstill Ranch, a ranch in Dun Morogh where Veron Amberstill breeds rams and trades in them. Rudra Amberstill fears for the herd, since a beast called Vagash has been taking rams from it, and Ice Claw bears roam the grounds. Turuk Amberstill, a dwarven weaponsmith, works here too.
You are in The Tundrid Hills, hill country in Dun Morogh. Snow leopards and ice claw bears hunt here, and a beast called Bjarn roams the hills as well.

You are in South Gate Outpost, an Alliance post in Dun Morogh. Mountaineer Barleybrew keeps watch from the southern guard tower near the Loch Modan border, and he likes to share his brother's Shimmer Stout with fellow mountaineers.

You are in North Gate Outpost, an Alliance post in Dun Morogh. Pilot Hammerfoot guards the siege engines here and grieves for his friend Mori Hildelve, a fellow pilot who was killed in the hills while searching for ore. Snow leopards prowl nearby, and Mangeclaw, a huge ice claw bear, roams the hills.

You are in the Gates of Ironforge, an area of Dun Morogh. Ironforge Guards send visitors on toward the auction house and the bank, and a spirit healer offers a return to life for a price. Jordan Stilwell, a smith and faithful friend of the paladins, is among those here.
